--E.Name: --E
--E.description: List of tags to exclude from the test, so only tasks with no matching tags will be executed

--autoquit.Name: --autoquit
--autoquit.description: Quits Locust entirely, X seconds after the run is finished

--autostart.Name: --autostart
--autostart.description: Starts the test immediately (without disabling the web UI)

--class-picker.Name: --class-picker
--class-picker.description: Enable select boxes in the web interface to choose from all available User classes and Shape classes

--csv.Name: --csv
--csv.description: Store current request stats to files in CSV format

--csv-full-history.Name: --csv-full-history
--csv-full-history.description: Store each stats entry in CSV format to _stats_history.csv file. You must also specify the '--csv' argument to enable this

--enable-rebalancing.Name: --enable-rebalancing
--enable-rebalancing.description: Allow to automatically rebalance users if new workers are added or removed during a test run

--equal-weights.Name: --equal-weights
--equal-weights.description: Use equally distributed task weights, overriding the weights specified in the locustfile

--exclude-tags.Name: --exclude-tags
--exclude-tags.description: List of tags to exclude from the test, so only tasks with no matching tags will be executed

--exit-code-on-error.Name: --exit-code-on-error
--exit-code-on-error.description: Sets the process exit code to use when a test result contain any failure or error

--expect-workers.Name: --expect-workers
--expect-workers.description: How many workers master should expect to connect before starting the test (only when --headless/autostart is used)

--expect-workers-max-wait.Name: --expect-workers-max-wait
--expect-workers-max-wait.description: How long should the master wait for workers to connect before giving up. Defaults to wait forever

--headless.Name: --headless
--headless.description: Disable the web interface, and start the test immediately

--help.Name: --help
--help.description: Show this help message and exit

--host.Name: --host
--host.description: Host to load test in the following format: http://10.21.32.33

--html.Name: --html
--html.description: Store HTML report to file path specified

--list.Name: --list
--list.description: Show list of possible User classes and exit

--locustfile.Name: --locustfile
--locustfile.description: Show program's version number and exit

--logfile.Name: --logfile
--logfile.description: Path to log file. If not set, log will go to stderr

--loglevel.Name: --loglevel
--loglevel.description: Choose between DEBUG/INFO/WARNING/ERROR/CRITICAL. Default is INFO

--master.Name: --master
--master.description: Set locust to run in distributed mode with this process as master

--master-bind-host.Name: --master-bind-host
--master-bind-host.description: Interfaces (hostname, ip) that locust master should bind to

--master-bind-port.Name: --master-bind-port
--master-bind-port.description: Port that locust master should bind to

--master-host.Name: --master-host
--master-host.description: Host or IP address of locust master for distributed load testing. Only used when running with --worker. Defaults to 127.0.0.1

--master-port.Name: --master-port
--master-port.description: Show list of possible User classes and exit

--reset-stats.Name: --reset-stats
--reset-stats.description: Reset statistics once spawning has been completed. Should be set on both master and workers when running in distributed mode

--run-time.Name: --run-time
--run-time.description: Stop after the specified amount of time, e.g. (300s, 20m, 3h, 1h30m, etc.)

--show-task-ratio.Name: --show-task-ratio
--show-task-ratio.description: Print table of the User classes' task execution ratio. Use this with non-zero --user option if some classes define non-zero fixed_count attribute

--show-task-ratio-json.Name: --show-task-ratio-json
--show-task-ratio-json.description: Print json data of the User classes' task execution ratio. Use this with non-zero --user option if some classes define non-zero fixed_count attribute

--skip-log-setup.Name: --skip-log-setup
--skip-log-setup.description: Disable Locust's logging setup. Instead, the configuration is provided by the Locust test or Python defaults. --loglevel LOGLEVEL, -L LOGLEVEL

--spawn-rate.Name: --spawn-rate
--spawn-rate.description: Rate to spawn users at (users per second). Primarily used together with --headless or --autostart

--tags.Name: --tags
--tags.description: List of tags to include in the test, so only tasks with any matching tags will be executed

--tls-cert.Name: --tls-cert
--tls-cert.description: Optional path to TLS certificate to use to serve over HTTPS

--tls-key.Name: --tls-key
--tls-key.description: Optional path to TLS private key to use to serve over HTTPS

--users.Name: --users
--users.description: Peak number of concurrent Locust users. Primarily used together with --headless or --autostart

--version.Name: --version
--version.description: Show program's version number and exit

--web-auth.Name: --web-auth
--web-auth.description: Turn on Basic Auth for the web interface. e.g. username:password

--web-host.Name: --web-host
--web-host.description: Host to bind the web interface to. Defaults to '*' (all interfaces)

--web-port.Name: --web-port
--web-port.description: Port on which to run web host

--worker.Name: --worker
--worker.description: Set locust to run in distributed mode with this process as worker

-H.Name: -H
-H.description: Host to load test in the following format: http://10.21.32.33

-P.Name: -P
-P.description: Port on which to run web host

-T.Name: -T
-T.description: List of tags to include in the test, so only tasks with any matching tags will be executed

-f.Name: -f
-f.description: Show program's version number and exit

-h.Name: -h
-h.description: Show this help message and exit

-l.Name: -l
-l.description: Show list of possible User classes and exit

-r.Name: -r
-r.description: Rate to spawn users at (users per second). Primarily used together with --headless or --autostart

-t.Name: -t
-t.description: Stop after the specified amount of time, e.g. (300s, 20m, 3h, 1h30m, etc.)

-u.Name: -u
-u.description: Peak number of concurrent Locust users. Primarily used together with --headless or --autostart

-v.Name: -v
-v.description: Show program's version number and exit
